decisions: Timeline layout: the two full-width spaces after each date became 4 ASCII spaces, and continuation lines keep the 11-space indent, so text stays aligned in a column (7-char date + 4 = 11). Trailing full-width padding converted to 2 ASCII spaces each.
All %s kept in source order (printf-style, cannot be reordered); English phrasing built around that order.
Battle template (%s ni sanka / %s ni toujou / %s hoka / teki MS %s ki gekiha) -> 'Fought in %s / piloted %s, / downed %s and others, / %s enemy MS in total'.
Past tense throughout for both the pilot's career and world events.
Name rows: 'ch' prefix kept, glossary 'en' spellings used.
uncertain: S00684: what the first %s holds (faction name?) - wrote 'Entered the %s / Officer Academy'; if %s is already a full school name the 'Officer Academy' line would duplicate it.
S00704: source hard-codes F91 as the named kill in the Jupiter Empire battle; translated literally ('downed F91 and others').
S00706: '%s' directly after the name with no space - kept as is; unclear if it is a variant tag like ' (Gentle)'.
S00708: saishuu keireki rendered 'Final Record' (could also be 'Final Career'/'Final Post').
S00712: oya/ko kirikae rendered 'Switch Parent/Child' (generation toggle) - inferred from Progress Mode family records.
S00715-S00763: assumed the 'ch' prefix is internal and left it; if it is shown to players it should be dropped.
S00762: source has (XV), glossary entry has (XB); kept (XV).
Line counts increased in S00684 (+2), S00694 (+1), S00704 (+1), S00705 (+1); orchestrator should check the vertical fit.
